title: Added a game within my game
author: Infinite-Aioli-6274
selftext:
When I was a kid, I loved this SNES game called Legend of the Mystical Ninja. There was an arcade you could go into and play little minigames, and for some reason I always thought that was the coolest thing.

I’m currently making a top-down shooter, and between missions you return to your base to upgrade your weapons and planes. The mechanic is this plucky young girl whose desk you can visit, and she has a game she “hacked” that you can play.

The main game is about fighting an evil corporation called the Directorate that’s stealing water from the Moon. The minigame is Directorate propaganda.

I built it with Opus 5.5. The initial prompt was pretty simple since it already had the context of the overall story. I told it I wanted the minigame to have a sort of retro Fallout-ish propaganda style with a catchy theme song. I gave it access to my ElevenLabs MCP and it created the song on its own. I was super impressed when Claude used the notes from the jingle

After that I asked it to add a bouncing water droplet sing-along animation. It also came up with little moments throughout the game where the mechanic narrates the stuff she supposedly hacked or changed.

The five levels took about 2-3 hours to make. The main game is already pixel art, so it reused the same pixel-art skill I’d been using for the rest of the project. There is a rain sound in the background because the home base is in a flooded dock of sorts. 

I'll post the actual game soon once I'm done with Act 1. I'm still tweaking the difficulty. I'm realizing that I'm not very good at top-down shooters and probably shouldn't base the difficulty curve on my lack of skill.
